prompt: Pick a workload shape and see which billing model actually wins:

options.label: Steady, predictable workload
options.content: Fixed-price wins. A droplet sized to your steady usage costs the same every month, with no surprises, and you're not paying a per-request premium for capacity you're using consistently anyway. Metered billing here just adds unpredictability with no real benefit — you already know what you need.

options.label: Spiky, unpredictable workload
options.content: Metered billing wins. A fixed-price box would need to be sized for your worst-case spike to avoid falling over — meaning you'd pay for that peak capacity 24/7 even during quiet periods. Metered billing scales with actual usage: quiet periods cost little, spikes cost more only while they're happening.
